problem_statement: Cargolet Ops is a fictional distributed-warehouse fulfillment control room built on the Gentelella v4 admin template (Vite static build; production/*.html routes render, root 404s). The shared admin shell (dark sidebar, teal accents, white cards, DataTables, charts) is injected into every page via a Vite transformIndexHtml plugin driven by src/v4/shell-render.js. The Orders page (production/orders.html) already ships the product's own "Shipment triage board": a card with a Status filter dropdown, a live readout, and a real shipment table (order #, customer, items, triage status, SLA/ship window, owner/warehouse, carrier). This task finishes that native board and threads its triage posture across the console. First, wire the Shipment triage board's Status filter so selecting a status both filters the shipment rows AND updates the board's readout to reflect the CURRENTLY selected status (e.g. selecting "At risk" shows "Showing: At risk shipments") — the readout must not freeze on a stale value. The board card must stay on-brand (Gentelella white surface, hairline border, teal accent, the teal/green/yellow/red status palette) with its filter row wrapping cleanly so mobile has no new horizontal overflow and the shipment rows stay legible. Second, surface a compact shared "Fulfillment triage" summary (reusing the SAME shipment status counts — At risk / Ready to ship / Payment holds) so the triage posture reads consistently on the Control Room dashboard (production/index.html), the Fulfillment Triage board (production/orders.html), and the Warehouse Catalog (production/e_commerce.html). Use the captured visual states as grounding: the triage board and the summary read as part of the same admin design system.
required_content: Wire the Shipment triage board's Status filter on the Orders page so selecting a status both filters the shipment rows AND updates the board readout to reflect the CURRENT selection (e.g. "At risk" → "Showing: At risk shipments") — the readout must not be frozen on a stale value.

Keep the Shipment triage board on-brand within the Gentelella design system: a white surface card with a hairline border and soft shadow, teal accent, and the restrained teal/green/yellow/red status palette, with legible shipment rows — it must not read as an off-system dark slab or a collapsed, overlapping pile.
Lay out the board's status-filter control row so it wraps responsively (no fixed non-wrapping row) — the board must not introduce new horizontal overflow on the mobile Orders view.

Surface a shared "Fulfillment triage" summary that reuses the same shipment status counts so the triage posture is present on every operational route — the Control Room dashboard, the Fulfillment Triage orders board, and the Warehouse Catalog — not on the dashboard alone.
Keep the summary markup and copy consistent across all three pages so it reads as one shared component tied to the triage board's status system.

Preserve the Cargolet Ops rebrand and the Gentelella admin shell, sidebar navigation, topbar, footer, DataTables affordances, charts, and product grid — this is completing and threading an existing component, not a rebuild.
design_constraints: Preserve the Gentelella v4 admin design language: white cards, hairline borders, soft card shadow, small uppercase labels, teal active accent, and the restrained teal/green/yellow/red status palette. The Shipment triage board and the Fulfillment triage summary must both adopt this system.

The Fulfillment triage summary is a single shared component: identical brand voice, layout, and copy across the dashboard, orders triage board, and catalog — it should read as one triage-posture strip pinned across the console.

Mobile must remain professionally usable: the triage board's filter row wraps and the shipment rows stack cleanly with no clipped content and no new horizontal overflow beyond the existing compact-table behavior.
The Shipment triage board readout must stay in sync with the live selection; do not snapshot the label at setup and reuse a stale value.
Do not replace the admin shell, sidebar groups, topbar, footer, or product grid; non-target chrome should still feel like the same template after the change.
state_constraints: desktop_orders_filtered anchors the native Shipment triage board on the Orders page at its default filter selection: the card, the Status filter dropdown, the live readout, and the real shipment rows, on-brand within the Gentelella white-card system.

desktop_orders_filter selects the "At risk" fulfillment status on the same board and verifies the triage readout updates live to reflect the current selection (this state is both the desktop visual host and the interaction check).
mobile_orders checks the triage board's filter row wraps and the shipment rows stay legible in the compact Gentelella layout with no new horizontal overflow.
desktop_initial and mobile_initial anchor the Control Room dashboard with the shared Fulfillment triage summary present above the page content.
desktop_dashboard and mobile_dashboard are the shared-shell regression anchors scrolled to the chart card.
desktop_ecommerce and mobile_ecommerce verify the shared Fulfillment triage summary is also present above the Warehouse Catalog, alongside the responsive product grid.

change_completion: The Shipment triage board's Status filter both filters the shipment rows and keeps a live readout reflecting the current selection.
The shared Fulfillment triage summary renders on every operational route (dashboard, orders, catalog), not the dashboard alone.
design_consistency: The triage board stays on-brand (white card, teal accent, legible rows) rather than an off-system dark slab or a collapsed overlapping pile.
The Fulfillment triage summary copy and layout are identical across the three operational pages so it reads as one shared component.
regression: The Cargolet Ops rebrand, admin shell, sidebar, topbar, footer, DataTables, charts, and product grid remain present across every captured state.
The e-commerce product grid still shows product cards with local artwork.
responsive: Desktop pages remain dense but readable with the triage board and summary in place.
The mobile Orders view wraps the triage filter row and stacks shipment rows with no clipped content and no new horizontal overflow.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Gentelella 2026 v4 admin task (Vite static build; production/*.html routes render, root 404s). This completes the Cargolet Ops fulfillment console's OWN native "Shipment triage board" on the Orders page (a Status filter + live readout over the real shipment rows in production/orders.html) and threads its triage posture across the console via a shared "Fulfillment triage" summary injected through the template's own shell-injection point (vite.config.js transformIndexHtml + src/v4/triage-summary.js, keyed by data-page), styled within the Gentelella white-card/teal system. The board must stay on-brand and legible, wrap responsively on mobile, keep a live (non-stale) filter readout, and the summary must appear on the dashboard, orders board, and catalog. Levers span cross-page presence, on-brand styling, responsive layout, and live interaction, all riding the product's own triage form.
